Package frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation

Class SimEncoder

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation.SimEncoder
public class SimEncoder extends Object
Simulated incremental encoder with optional quantization and noise.
